study_type.rationale: The ENA project is a SELEX-library-strategy sequencing deposit (16 candidate libraries subjected to 30 rounds of selection) reporting genuine aptamer-selection reads against a small-molecule target, not a transcription-factor motif study.
study_type.evidence_quote: In this study, we selected 16 candidates for PFOA aptamers in order to find a selective and sensitive aptamer. After 30 rounds of selection, one candidate, Candidate 9, showed a measurable binding affinity with a kd of 2 µM

target.evidence_quote: This study identifies an aptamer that selectively binds to perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA).

target_class.evidence_quote: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) is a toxic, bioaccumulative chemical that is present globally in water.

n_rounds.evidence_quote: After 30 rounds of selection, one candidate, Candidate 9, showed a measurable binding affinity with a kd of 2 µM

counter_selection.note: Counter-selection was performed against structurally similar PFAS/chemicals; hairpin-structure enrichment increased after its addition and the aptamer gave no signal with the counter-selection chemicals.
counter_selection.evidence_quote: 2D structure analysis demonstrated an enrichment of hairpin structure, especially after the addition of counter-selection... did not produce signal with other PFAS or chemicals used in counter-selection.

study_type.rationale: The deposit contains genuine iterative Helicase-SELEX selection-round reads (starting genomic libraries plus round-10 enriched libraries) used to map the natural sequence motif recognized by a regulatory protein (Rho transcription-termination factor), analogous to TF-HT-SELEX motif mapping rather than de novo aptamer-reagent discovery, even though the bound protein is an RNA-binding helicase rather than a classic DNA-binding transcription factor.
study_type.evidence_quote: We have used a global screening approach called Helicase-SELEX...to identify Rho helicase substrate sequences (aka Rut sequences) within the genome of Mycobacterium tuberculosis...After 10 rounds of this iterative enrichment process, the activity of each library towards the Rho helicase became constant and its composition was determined by NGS.

study_type.rationale: The deposit contains genuine SELEX enrichment-round sequencing reads (Round 5 preliminary screening plus Round 2 secondary screening) across 96 protein targets, i.e. real aptamer-selection data, even though the associated study frames itself as a scalable computational/inference framework rather than a single-aptamer discovery paper.

Four random ssDNA libraries (lib10, lib13, lib18, lib25) were each applied to 24 targets. After 5 rounds of preliminary screening, the Round 5 library was sequenced.

study_type.rationale: The paper performs a classic single-protein SELEX-seq (purified 6xHis-tagged effector protein incubated with a 16-nt random dsDNA library across 5 iterative selection rounds, sequenced, and MEME-analyzed for a consensus binding motif) to map the DNA sequence motif recognized by effector protein Hg4E02, which the paper shows acts as a transcriptional regulator on host gene promoters. This matches TF-motif-mapping HT-SELEX methodology rather than de novo aptamer-reagent discovery.
study_type.evidence_quote: To identify the DNA elements recognized by Hg4E02, we performed systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment coupled with next-generation sequencing (SELEX-seq). Purified 6×His-Hg4E02 was incubated with a double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) library containing 16 mers of random nucleotides flanked by adapters. The binders were amplified and used as the library for the next round of SELEX. After 5 rounds of selections, the dsDNA library was sequenced, and consensus motifs were identified using MEME.
study_type.location: Section 2.4 "SCN Effector Hg4E02 Is a Transcriptional Regulator Targeting Multiple Soybean Circadian Clock Gene Promoters", p.8

target.evidence_quote: Purified 6×His-Hg4E02 was incubated with a double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) library containing 16 mers of random nucleotides flanked by adapters.

target_class.evidence_quote: SCN Effector Hg4E02 Is a Transcriptional Regulator Targeting Multiple Soybean Circadian Clock Gene Promoters ... Since Hg4E02 is a small protein (7.5 kDa) and could activate or inhibit gene expression, Hg4E02 probably functions with a transcriptional activator or repressor to regulate gene expression.

chemistry.value: 72-nt single-stranded DNA library synthesized with a 16-nt degenerate (random) region and Illumina-compatible adapters, converted to double-stranded DNA for the binding/selection steps
chemistry.evidence_quote: The 72-nt single-strand DNA library was synthesized with a 16-nt degenerate sequence, and short sequence adapters were added to be compatible with the Illumina platform... The initial library was used as the template to generate the dsDNA library.

n_random.evidence_quote: The 72-nt single-strand DNA library was synthesized with a 16-nt degenerate sequence, and short sequence adapters were added to be compatible with the Illumina platform.

n_rounds.evidence_quote: After 5 rounds of selections, the dsDNA library was sequenced, and consensus motifs were identified using MEME... The screening processes were repeated another four times.

selection_format.evidence_quote: we performed systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment coupled with next-generation sequencing (SELEX-seq).

counter_selection.note: The full-text Methods (Section 4.14) describe only a single positive-selection scheme (bead-immobilized 6xHis-Hg4E02 incubated with the dsDNA library, washed, eluted, PCR-amplified for 5 total rounds); no counter-selection or negative-selection step (e.g., pre-clearing against beads alone or an unrelated protein) is described anywhere in the SELEX-seq protocol.
